text:
During multiple-sprint exercise, blood concentrations of hypoxanthine, inosine, and uric acid rise, because ADP is degraded through AMP and IMP and these purine products leave the muscle. Hypoxanthine and inosine are the most consistently elevated, with uric acid following as hypoxanthine is oxidised. I did not check these against sources in this session, and the size of the rise depends on the sport and sampling time.

CONFIDENCE: 60
